mapper.insert: INSERT INTO problem_reports (problem_id, user_id, content) VALUES (#{problemId}, #{userId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.report_id, r.problem_id, cp.title AS problem_title, r.user_id, u.nickname, r.content, r.status, r.created_at FROM problem_reports r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN coding_problems cp ON r.problem_id = cp.problem_id ORDER BY r.status ASC, r.created_at DESC

SELECT r.report_id, r.problem_id, cp.title AS problem_title, r.user_id, u.nickname, r.content, r.status, r.created_at FROM problem_reports r JOIN users u ON r.user_id = u.user_id JOIN coding_problems cp ON r.problem_id = cp.problem_id WHERE r.problem_id = #{problemId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE problem_reports SET status = 'RESOLVED' WHERE report_id = #{reportId}
